subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should OpenClaw support a validated host-path remapping contract for Docker Gateway/DooD sandbox managed mounts, or keep identical host/container paths as the supported Docker install contract?
rationale: The choice changes sandbox bind-source trust boundaries, operator setup compatibility, and whether the fix needs config/schema/doctor support, so automation should not choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define Secure Remapping Contract
options.body: Add or sponsor a validated mapping path for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, custom, and browser mounts, with docs/schema/doctor coverage as needed and live DooD proof.

options.title: Keep Identical-Path Contract
options.body: Document and enforce that Docker Gateway deployments must mount the same host path inside the Gateway container and add a doctor warning for mismatched setups.

options.title: Land Narrow Skill Repair Only
options.body: Treat the open materialized-skills PR as partial work while leaving this canonical workspaceAccess issue open for the broader managed-mount contract.

recommendation.title: Define Secure Remapping Contract
recommendation.body: Add or sponsor a validated mapping path for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, custom, and browser mounts, with docs/schema/doctor coverage as needed and live DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They already marked this issue canonical and have recent Docker/sandbox history relevant to the boundary decision.
